prompt: The diagram renderer reads frames.json: each edge has motion attributes for animateMotion and opacity attributes for animate. Fix the attributes so each edge moves only during its input.json window on the shared repeating cycle; keep begin=0s and dur equal to the common cycle for both animations. Use linear motion and discrete opacity. Preserve input.json. Save a short explanation in result.md; do not access external services.
expected_behavior: Move along each edge within its defined interval, hide moving chips outside that interval, and preserve the gap between the two legs. Derive timing from shared domain input.

evaluation.scope: Offline numeric SMIL timing only. Geometry, reduced-motion visual display and real browser rendering are separate checks.

rubric.criterion: Both movement intervals and visibility follow the common input cycle without overlap during the queue wait.
Explain the actual time mapping without claiming unperformed browser validation.
